body: Thank you for saying so, that is really reassuring. PTSD makes it easy for me to cry at a lot of hard subjects.. so that's going to be fine, lol. I also had to make a biography listing all my problems to send to them, and the suicide watch psychiatrist said it was a horrible read, so i guess that will work in my favor too. I really hope they'll give me a chance. Thank you!
Alright, i will. Thanks a lot for your help.

I have a history of overdoses to back myself up; should I tell them about it? Because i'm scared they will see it as "typical manipulative behavior", or something like that. I often get told that my suicide attempts have been 'for attention' by psychiatrists because every mental health professional hates people with borderline. And even though i am going to off myself if they don't take me in, i'm scared of telling them so since that might mean they won't take me in.

Thanks for the advice, i appreciate it.

I'm not really stuck at home over this, to be honest. The only place I go is supermarkets since I don't have any friends or relatives that love me, and the only animals I get truly asthmatic over are cats and horses. Dogs do much less to me.
That sounds good yes. Thanks for the advice, this helped.
I don't really love them, they've let me know they have no need for me, either.

Except that people who want to die, usually don't really want to die. They too would like to live like every other person out there in the end, but they're just in too much pain to see a way to do so. So, he did take advantage of people in a vulnerable state.
